title: Prove exact dense B3/C3 term costs three or five (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped written proof with exact finite corroboration. For the full dense B3/C3 root-code model over every coefficient field of characteristic other than two:

```text
one coefficient vector uses one coordinate  -> term cost 3
both coefficient vectors use at least two   -> term cost 5
m nonzero terms, h in the second case       -> exact invoice 3m+2h
```

The costs are binary pairing ranks, separately from the coefficient field. This identifies the exact two-rank surcharge left undetermined by ywz65's PR2582 universal per-term floor. Its existing optimum nine is not claimed as new: an admissible decoder attains it exactly when m=3 and h=0. The proof and checker were produced by Nick Petalas. Research stopped at this first formula.

The six-file package is `research/dense-bc3-term-tariff/`; start with `PROOF.md`. It collapses identical signed-edge rows and computes a three-dimensional Schur complement. PR2582's cross-star bound is a cited premise, not an audit deliverable. Retain Aaron Wang's PR2272/PR2518 root-generator and screen credit, DreamingOfClouds' PR2228/PR2277 root-code method and the credited earlier lineage. Older PR4863 concerns intermediate-axis punctures in dimensions at least four and proves a different result.

## Evidence

Before, the cited theorem supplied the lower bound three in this dimension. After, the new formula prices every term exactly, with an explicit condition for cost three versus five.

Local CPython 3.12.15 checks passed:

- All 49 nonempty coordinate-support pairs, with binary elimination and a separately implemented finite-span oracle: 33 cost three and 16 cost five.
- All 296,784 ordered literal coefficient-pair instances across B3/C3, covering all nonzero vectors in `{-2,-1,0,1,2}^3` over Q and over F3, F5 and F7. Literal integer-root orthogonality constructs the pairing independently of the incidence proof.
- Six invalid support inputs, two wrong tariffs and four model-boundary escapes. Three deliberately mutated optimized scripts are rejected by the actual support or literal-root checks.
- Both registered commands, metadata/pins, committed bytes/modes and full declared source-history ancestry. Final warning-strict direct checks took 0.116 and 0.122 seconds, respectively; these are timeout measurements, not a speedup claim. Normal and optimized generated reports agree byte for byte.
- Official committed export integrity/input coverage and read-only Git-free normal/optimized replay with empty PATH; reports match and all seven bundled files remain unchanged. Static parsing/compilation and whitespace checks pass.

Reproduce from the repository root with the actual local interpreter path, or another CPython 3.12 executable:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/dense-bc3-term-tariff/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/dense-bc3-term-tariff/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/dense-bc3-term-tariff
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/dense-bc3-term-tariff --check-source-history --check-modes
```

Expected markers: `PASS_DENSE_BC3_TERM_TARIFF`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`. Receipts are generated from the enumeration and bind the six package files by SHA256. No receipt is handwritten.

## Limitations

The universal conclusion is a written proof, with finite corroboration. Full root sets, the fixed dense orthogonality pairing, root-code factors and characteristic other than two are essential. Admissibility is separate from the exact invoice. Sparse pairings, punctures, external factors and higher dimensions are outside scope.

No physical supplier, native map, access/restoration schedule, hosting, precision, stock, tape, uniform compiler, outer admission or complete multiplication theorem is supplied. All five framework assumptions and selected PR6030 remain unchanged. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. Every registered check ran locally; no mathematical check is deferred to CI. Selected cold replay, Lean and Docker were not run for this isolated package.

The helper-inventory card is explicitly changed to a local algebraic side result. Upstream main remained `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a` at submission. Cached overlap completely paginated 575 open PRs and 6,645 Discussion records, with live precommit deltas and all-main README searches. The sparse helper's local note coverage, arbitrary historical diffs and unpublished work remain limitations. [Advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19375577).

## Open next questions

- Derive an exact coordinate-support tariff in dimension four, beginning with its unsigned incidence blocks. The larger edge block needs a new argument.
- Classify admissible three-term cost-nine factorizations by solving their biorthogonal equations under h=0. The tariff condition alone gives no scalar or physical realization.

Neither question is reserved; fresh overlap checking is required.

## Related open work

- PR3045 studies per-term fitting-pairing ranks and square root-code floors on E8/P112/P104/D4. This package fixes the dense B3/C3 pairing and gives its exact term cost; no common numerical result is compared.
- PR2832 studies universality and batching reductions for E8-line decoder costs. This package neither proves those reductions nor supplies an E8 bound.
- PR3154 reduces the P112 decoder floor to named conjectures. The B3/C3 formula does not resolve those conjectures.

Completion refresh checked the ten other open PRs created by this account since the advance claim: PR6627, PR6628, PR6629, PR6630, PR6631, PR6634, PR6644, PR6645, PR6646 and PR6647. None studies the dense B3/C3 term cost or reports the same formula; no shared numerical disagreement was identified. No extra scientific computation was run for this refresh.

## CI notes

All hosted checks passed at head `c9935144bcc40cbe7b613cd603ed91de779697ad`: `plan` and `replay (research/dense-bc3-term-tariff)`, in [run 41651287001](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41651287001). The completed checks were read once; run metadata independently confirms the same head. These checks certify the registered replay, not independent scientific acceptance. All listed local checks also passed.

## Merge danger

Two-way door. Blast radius: isolated. Only a new six-file research package is added; no shared code, predecessor artifact or selected-frontier record changes.
